Item.Description: Item number identifying the stimulus in the source list.

Word.Description: Written form of the novel-language stimulus.

Sound_File.Description: Filename of the audio recording associated with the stimulus.

Condition.Description: Experimental condition code assigned to the stimulus.

Base_Form.Description: Code identifying the base form associated with the stimulus.

Affix_Form.Description: Pattern representing the affix form associated with the stimulus.

Translation_List.Description: Identifier of the translation list associated with the stimulus.

Base_Meaning.Description: Semantic meaning associated with the base form.

Base_Category.Description: Semantic category associated with the base meaning.

Affix_Meaning.Description: Semantic meaning assigned to the affix.

MJ1_English_Translation.Description: English translation for the first meaning judgment.

MJ1_Hebrew_Translation.Description: Hebrew translation for the first meaning judgment.

MJ1_Translation_Type.Description: Type or correctness classification of the first meaning judgment translation.

MJ2_English_Translation.Description: English translation for the second meaning judgment.

MJ2_Hebrew_Translation.Description: Hebrew translation for the second meaning judgment.

MJ2_Translation_Type.Description: Type or correctness classification of the second meaning judgment translation.

list_type.Description: Indicates whether the stimulus belongs to the trained or untrained list.
